_doc: County address-point layers that fill the gaps in USDOT NAD (#393): house-address crashes in counties NAD doesn't cover. backend/scripts/fetch_address_points.py turns each into data/cache/nad/addr_<name>.csv in NAD's columns; nad.NadIndex reads every addr_*.csv next to the NAD file. Field mappings follow OpenAddresses (github.com/openaddresses/openaddresses, sources/<oa>). Another state: add its layers here the same way. licence: what the publisher says (checked 2026-11-04, #393); only sources with licence_ok true are fetched without --measure. label: the source line shown on a placed crash (SanGIS prescribes its wording).
